_what: GENERATED — do not edit src/index.ts. It is byte-compared against a fresh generation by `pnpm bindings:check`, so a hand edit is indistinguishable from drift and is reported as drift. Regenerate with `pnpm bindings:write` and commit the result WITH the contract change that caused it. wasmSha256 says which build these describe; stellarCli says which generator produced them, because a CLI upgrade and a contract change look identical in the diff and are entirely different problems.
